body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Original) An air delivery system for clinical management and/or prediction of a patient's respiratory exacerbations, comprising:a controllable flow generator operable to generate a supply of pressurized breathable gas to be provided to the patient for treatment;
a pulse oximeter configured to generate a signal indicative of the patient's relative breathing effort, breathing frequency, and/or breathing phase; and
a controller configured to determine the patient's relative breathing effort, breathing frequency, and/or breathing phase based on the signal generated by the pulse oximeter.
2. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the patient's breathing phase includes inspiratory and/or expiratory timing.
3. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to derive a representation of the patient's respiratory efficiency from inherent arterial oxygenation information provided by the pulse oximeter and the patient's relative breathing effort.
4. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the controller is further configured to discriminate between a central apnea and a mixed apnea.
5. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to discriminate between a central apnea and a mixed apnea based on whether breathing effort precedes oxygen desaturation.
6. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to discriminate between a central apnea and a mixed apnea based on a pattern recognition and/or classifier techniques.
7. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the pulse oximeter is a finger pulse oximeter.
8. (Original) The air delivery system of claim 1, wherein the pulse oximeter is configured to be located at the patient's ear.
9. (Withdrawn) An air delivery system with a provision for assessment of a patient's endothelial dysfunction, comprising:
a controllable flow generator operable to generate a supply of pressurized breathable gas to be provided to the patient for treatment;
a pulse oximeter configured to measure the patient's vasoconstrictive response to the treatment; and
a controller configured to trend the patient's vasoconstrictive response over a given time period to indicate a change in the patient's endothelial function.
10. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the pulse oximeter is a finger pulse oximeter.
11. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the pulse oximeter is configured to be located at the patient's ear.
12. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the pulse oximeter is configured to measure spontaneous respiratory-related arousals and/or periodic respiratory- related arousals.
13. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the spontaneous respiratory- related arousals and/or periodic respiratory-related arousals include changes in the patient's vascular compliance.
14. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the controller is configured to restore a pressure of the breathable gas to a previous level when venous congestion worsens.
Appl. No. 18/329,065 15. (Withdrawn) The air delivery system of claim 9, wherein the time period is one of days, weeks, or months.
